visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair in two braids, wearing a white short-sleeved blouse and a blue denim-textured apron, stands in a bright white studio. She sings dramatically with her arms raised and eyes closed. In a blurred, sepia-toned background overlay, a group of people in farm-style vests and hats appear to be milking a person dressed in a cow-patterned bodysuit. (2) A hand enters the frame from the right, offering a glass of milk to the woman. She stops singing, smiles broadly, and drinks the milk in one large gulp, looking satisfied while holding the glass with both hands. (3) A young boy in a brown scout hat and suspenders speaks directly to the camera, gesturing toward the background where the 'human cow' is being tended to. He appears to be explaining a situation, while the woman in the foreground looks frustrated and begins shouting with her mouth wide open. (4) The boy is shown again, now looking tired and leaning his head on his hand as he continues to speak. He then presents a large yellow can of KLIM milk powder, pointing at the label which prominently features '100% 純生乳'. (5) The boy demonstrates making milk using the KLIM powder. He pours water from a pink kettle into a clear glass cup that features a cartoon cow logo and a measurement scale. He stirs the mixture vigorously with a small spoon until it turns opaque white. (6) The boy puts a lid on the cup, shakes it slightly, and takes a long drink, giving a thumbs-up and looking very pleased with the taste. The woman reappears, standing next to him as they both present the KLIM can to the viewer. (7) In the final sequence, the woman and boy pose together, smiling and holding the KLIM cup. The boy shows the cup's interior design, highlighting the ratio markings. The video ends with the boy making a funny face next to the large milk powder can.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Orchestral strings swell as a woman sings 'The Hills are Alive' with high energy and a clear, theatrical soprano pitch. BGM is triumphant and major-key. (2) A sharp liquid pouring sound effect follows. The woman's voice shifts to a casual, satisfied conversational tone with high valence as she drinks. (3) A high-pitched cartoon 'ping' SFX triggers as variety text appears. A young boy speaks with clear, rapid-fire articulation in an energetic, high-arousal tone. (4) Loud shouting and comedic yelling from the woman occurs, punctuated by 'boing' and comic 'whoosh' sound effects. BGM tempo remains steady and bright. (5) BGM shifts to an upbeat, rhythmic piano and synth jingle. The boy's voice takes on an informative, promotional tone, describing the milk powder product. (6) Distinct foley sounds of a metal lid popping open and water splashing into a glass cup are heard. The boy continues his upbeat narration with clear articulation. (7) The woman and boy speak together in a high-energy conclusion, overlapping their voices. A loud, exaggerated 'Moo' animal sound concludes the master audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, exaggerated skit about the difficulty of obtaining fresh milk (featuring a human 'cow') to capture attention. It then pivots to promote KLIM 100% milk powder as a convenient, delicious, and high-quality alternative that solves the supply problem while highlighting a special promotional cup.
